text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear three-part structure with \"Firstly,\" \"Second reason,\" \"Finally,\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay lays out its reasons in a clear sequence that makes the argument easy to follow."},{"evidence":"each body paragraph centers on one claim","quality":"focus","description":"The essay stays on a single supporting point in each paragraph instead of drifting across several ideas at once."},{"evidence":"article details such as sensors, work zones, and liability","quality":"use of evidence","description":"The essay more directly draws on specific information from the source article to support its position."},{"evidence":"explains how a distracted driver could cause a fatal accident","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay develops its reasons by showing the likely consequences of each problem rather than just naming them."},{"evidence":"restates the main three objections in the closing sentence","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends by pulling its reasons back together into a summary of the argument."}]}
